contribution_method: Original physical unit maps uniquely into one arrived procurement intent; actual transfer value plus actual receipt gas, allocated equally only if batch has multiple units.
Actual seller receipt cash is already net of redeemed mileage; prior mileage spending is not subtracted again.
Full newly earned lot amount including the extra bonus is charged conservatively at issuance; future redemption/refund accounting is separate.

This is verified transaction contribution, not fully allocated final profit. Holding/operating costs not separately attributable are not allocated; bundled procurement payments may already include charges.
No cached accounting unit-price field is queried or used.
limitations: No exposure/conversion causality from a simple before/after window.
PRE must end at actual stop/cutoff; POST starts at verified readiness, excluding deployment downtime.
Two-hour buckets compare equal duration; a final short bucket is explicitly labelled by its seconds.
Raw customer text, rights, wallet identifiers, transaction hashes and Model reasoning are excluded.
